nuora.aspetto: an uncanny young widow in her early thirties who looks healthy but wrong, like a familiar face that is different from how you remember it: a slim, healthy figure; a very long, narrow face with a high, smooth forehead; big dark eyes, too big for the face; thin, high-arched eyebrows; a long thin nose; a small full mouth; a very long thin neck; long straight black hair parted in the middle; long thin fingers; in a black long-sleeved dress, a man's gold wedding ring hanging on a thin chain around her neck

parti.occhi: Big, dark eyes, too big for her face, the rims a little red from crying; the whites are clear: no fever, no sweat.
parti.bocca: Small, full, pale lips, a little bitten; healthy, even teeth; nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: her very long neck and the base of her throat above the collar of the black dress
collo.segni: On a thin gold chain around her long neck hangs a man's plain gold wedding ring, too big for her; the skin of the neck is smooth and healthy: no swelling, no lumps.

ascelle.inquadratura: her left armpit and the inside of her raised upper arm, nothing else: she raises her left arm, the long black sleeve pushed up to the shoulder, while the black dress still covers her chest and her side completely
ascelle.segni: Pale, healthy skin in the armpit, with no swelling and no marks at all.

mani.inquadratura: both hands held out in front, palms up, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Long, thin fingers; the hands are red, raw and deeply chapped, the skin cracked and peeling on the fingers and the knuckles, as from scrubbing with bleach several times a day for weeks; otherwise healthy, the fingertips normal.
